Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1071
Claimant:
Mary Baker
Adjuster:
Darin Tyler
29 Dec 2024
Claim received for a low-speed collision in a parking lot. Insured reports being rear-ended while stopped at a painted
stall. Claimant is represented by counsel, and all contact will route through their office.
11 Jan 2025
Confirmed the driver is listed on the policy and the coverage period was active on the date of loss. Nothing in the file
suggests the vehicle damage predates the policy start.
30 Jan 2025
Reviewed scene photographs. They confirm the general position of both vehicles and the rear-end contact. No
independent witnesses have come forward, and the police report confirms the claimant was in the vehicle at the time.
1 Feb 2025
Vehicle inspection completed. Most of the damage lines up with the described impact. A few old scratches near the
lower bumper may predate this loss, and I have noted them separately for the appraiser.
14 Feb 2025
Claimant's account has been consistent across every conversation so far, including the initial report, the recorded
statement, and the follow-up call with counsel present.
24 Mar 2025
Medical records received for the reported back strain. The injury fits the type and force of the collision. The patient
had a minor strain in the same area years ago, which healed fully and is documented in prior records.
6 May 2025
Treatment followed a typical course, with physical therapy and reduced visits as the paitent improved. The provider's
notes show steady progress and a tapering schedule that matches expected recovery.
5 Jul 2025
File is ready for evaluation. Liability and coverage are straightforward on the current record. Medical and property
amounts will be assessed on the dcouments as they stand, with the prior strain and the older scratches noted for
review.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
